'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Amar Banger DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Amar Banger]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster]]
* '''Username:''' abanger
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
